attribution.description: The Oak Alley plantation mansion in Louisiana is protected as a National Historic Landmark of the United States of America. Its formal National Register of Historic Places designation number is 74002187.

attribution.title: The Big House - Whitney Plantation Historic District - 2016
attribution.author: Bill Leiser
attribution.description: The Big House, seen in the movie "Django Unchained."  Raised French Creole style cottage was built of masonry and cypress in the late 18th century. It is one of the earliest and best preserved Creole plantation houses standing on River Road. Sometime prior to 1815, the Big House was expanded to its present configuration with seven rooms on each level, plus a full-length gallery across the front and an open loggia facing the rear. This is also one of the very few historic American houses known to have received decorative wall paintings on both its exterior and interior.
